key_terms.حٰمٓ: Disjointed letters (Al-Huruf al-Muqatta'at) appearing at the start of Surah Ash-Shura, consisting of Ha and Mim.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the disjointed letters Ha Mim in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the disjointed letters 'Ha Mim' are often viewed as divine abbreviations or oaths that underscore the miraculous nature of the Quran, inviting reflection on its linguistic inimitability. This specific invocation appears in Surah Ash-Shura, linking the mystery of the letters to the revelation of divine guidance and the authority of the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt.
